text:
marco: @ana heads-up — Zenith opened a P1 via support: p95 latency on their Dedicated pool jumped from ~220ms to ~1.8s after last night's canary. They want an ETA and are pushing to move this up the roadmap because it's blocking a renewal. Logs attached in the ticket.

jin: copied. Ticket RDW-2981 has traces + timeline. Support saw a burst around 13:12 UTC with many retries and some 503s. Customer reports user-facing slowdowns and a few duplicate requests.

ana: need to decide: emergency hotfix vs backlog item. Sales is already asking for SLA remediation if we can't mitigate quickly. What's the suspected root cause?

sofia: initial signal -> KV cache invalidation after the deploy. Cold cache + longer seq lengths leads to heavier decode times and request queueing. Also autoscaler didn't spin up new nodes due to our burst policy threshold.

derek: verified traces locally from their pool. Snippet:
```
error: queue_timeout exceeded, retry_count=2
latencies: p50 210ms p95 1.78s p99 3.6s
```

ops-bot: alert created #inc-2026-783, paging eng-oncall and eng-platform.

carla: short-term mitigation possible: enable per-customer burst on Zenith and provision +2 GPUs to their Dedicated pool. Ops estimate ~30-45m to provision and smoke-test.

ana: can we do that without impacting other customers? Need rollback plan and quick cost note for sales.

sofia: yes — we can route Zenith to a separate burst pool. Also can flip a model-variant fallback to `small-compat` for very long requests and bump KV cache TTL to avoid re-warming on restarts as an interim.

marco: sales asks for timeline for renewal convo. If we can do the burst within 1h and confirm p95 <300ms, they will delay escalation.

jin: updated RDW-2981 with steps and requested a short maintenance window with Zenith at 14:30 UTC.

derek: action items: (1) carla provision +2 GPUs (owner: carla) ETA 45m; (2) sofia enable fallback + caching TTL (owner: sofia) ETA 30m; (3) ana coordinate backlog reprioritization for RDW-2981 and set launch criteria (p95 <350ms sustained 1h); (4) jin handle customer comms. I'll monitor.

ana: moving RDW-2981 to "urgent" in the backlog and tagging infra/runtime. We'll review in tomorrow's roadmap sync for the permanent fix (autoscaler policy change + persistent caching).

carla: provisioning started, will post progress and test results.

sofia: toggled fallback on canary for Zenith traffic, sampled results look promising — p95 dropped to ~320ms on sampled requests. Rolling to +10% now.

marco: thanks. Please post final verification and a quick cost estimate for the burst. Also add a short blurb for the renewal packet.

ops-bot: #inc-2026-783 updated: status=mitigating, assigned=eng-platform, priority=P1

derek: monitoring dashboard shows p95 trending down. Leaving this thread open until stable for 1 hour post-rollout. If we hit stability I'll move to postmortem checklist and ensure roadmap ticket captures scope and acceptance criteria.
